summary.valueString: The document is a professional profile of Kristen Connelly, a Video Production Assistant with three years of experience in online video production for commercials and short films. Kristen is skilled in using Premiere Pro and has contributed to increased audience engagement through effective video editing. The employment history includes roles at Blue Penguin Designs and Botle Bob Advertising, where Kristen was responsible for various production tasks, including equipment management and video editing. Kristen holds a BA in Film and Television from Boston University and has completed advanced courses in digital video editing. Additional certifications include Hootsuite Certified Professional and Adobe CS5 Certified. The document also lists skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and language proficiency in English, Dutch, and Flemish.
